slug: 2026-03-31 Africa we have a data problem

facts.fact: The Data Landscapers review (an AI-assisted compilation) states that rural schools in Burkina Faso are predominantly paper-based, with data aggregated and digitised at district level, and that it found no evidence of digital tools for direct entry of attendance, enrolment or grades in rural primary schools; no date is given, so the publication date is used.

The Data Landscapers review (an AI-assisted compilation) states that limited pilots such as the FIUE-BF student database exist but are not widespread in rural areas, giving no count of schools; no date is given, so the publication date is used.

systems.tiers: national; education statistics based on annual school census questionnaires
limited pilots, not widespread in rural areas
